nodes.label: SAC80k Session Evidence
nodes.rationale: Eight historical sessions used SAC80k torque. Six integrity-valid bags contain 313,555 messages: one Nav2 SUCCEEDED, three ABORTED, two without goals. Two corrupt bags remain diagnostic. Nav2 status and AMCL error do not establish physical arrival, stopping, comparative benefit, or TD3 deployment. All operator outcomes remain null.

nodes.label: Native Velocity Reference Backend
nodes.rationale: The next real SysID campaign selects firmware velocity mode because the intended TD3 controller adjusts bounded velocity references. The proposed chain passes shaping and Collision Monitor before /cmd_vel and the motor velocity loop. It was not run during restoration. Pi torque PI and historical SAC torque remain separate.

nodes.label: Historical Actuator Recording Gap
nodes.rationale: Historical run_logged_real.sh omitted /cmd_torque, /motor_enable, /cmd_mit, /scan_raw, and /collision_monitor_state. Controller total is a calculated command rather than measured torque or firmware receipt. Stale inputs, TF extrapolation, and EKF timing faults require causal timing analysis without changing stamps or deadlines to hide faults.

nodes.label: Sensor Only Restore
nodes.rationale: A historical sensor-only window restored Agent, raw sensors, bridge, EKF, and required sensor TF while isolating bridge enable. It observed approximately 47 Hz IMU/wheel/status and 7 Hz scans. No actuator publishers, AMCL map TF, active Collision Monitor, or live STOP validation were present. Observed rates and ages are not latency guarantees.

nodes.label: Mounting Contract Divergence
nodes.rationale: The Pi SAC branch has a 23D observation, torque residual, and identity IMU mounting, whereas the repository TD3/history branch has another ABI/action contract and earlier evidence used approximate offsets with yaw +90 degrees. Configuration differences require firmware/frame/mounting reconciliation rather than overwriting historical evidence.

nodes.label: Logging V2 Preparation
nodes.rationale: run_logged_real_v2.sh was prepared and syntax checked to add missing actuator and guard channels. Recording with it was not run; it is an augmented historical navigation runner rather than a released velocity diagnostic helper. A proposed 0.05 m/s, 0.10 m/s², 2 s source, 60 s bag diagnostic precedes any bounded repeats.
